items.title: Ladd McConkey: Practicing again, but still in protocol
items.text:
Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said McConkey remains in concussion protocol but will practice Wednesday, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Questionable for Thursday
items.text:
Golden (shoulder/foot) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Panthers, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

items.title: DJ Moore: Practicing, but not yet taking contact
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) was spotted on the field for the open portion of Wednesday's practice but was donning a no-contact jersey, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Won't practice Wednesday
items.text:
